clips.title: The story
paras: With the wand in hand, Skuerto turns to the ogres that surround the Tower of Arathor. To bring the tower's defenses to life, he needs an azure agate from the Boulderfist shaman, to be taken to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.
Ogres surround the Tower of Arathor in Stromgarde. Skuerto says the tower's defenses must be activated if you are to stand a chance against them and still reach the items alive.

Certain gems from the tower have caught the fancy of the Boulderfist shaman, who carried them off, though Skuerto says they will not keep them for long. Bring one azure agate to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe, who knows the spell to enchant it so that it works as a key.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here's our next step: there're ogres all around the Tower of Arathor in Stromgarde. We're gonna need to activate the tower's defenses if you're gonna stand a chance against 'em an' still make it to the items alive. To do that, we're gonna need some gems the Boulderfist shaman have taken a liking to. They took 'em from the tower, but they're not gonna stay in their possession for long.
Get one of them gems an' bring 'em to Kryten--he knows the spell to enchant 'em so they'll work as a key.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, hello again. Have you found an azure agate yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You amaze me, friend. Well done again.
Give me a moment to cast the proper spell to enchant the gem, an' you'll be ready.
